title: Cryptographic consent attestations
description: Records that a wallet has cryptographically attested to one or more off-chain legal documents identified by their keccak256 content hashes. Pattern: off-chain document semantics, on-chain anchor for shared reference integrity. Multi-valued — an agreement can bind to several documents simultaneously (e.g., ToS + Privacy Policy + NDA + custom merchant-buyer terms). The designer AFFIXES each document at design time (pinned off-chain, anchored by hash); the parties' EIP-712 signatures over the agreement root that merkle-includes this section ARE the acceptance — consent as an agreement term, no separate ceremony. Each entry preserves the (documentHash, documentVersion, documentTitle) tuple needed by counterparties, auditors, and arbitrators to reason about shared references over time; the consenter is recoverable from the signatures on the commitment. Append-only: revocation is a separate off-chain process, not a content mutation.

fields.name: documents
documentHash
fields.description: keccak256 of the canonical document text. 32-byte content anchor; any byte-level change rotates the hash.

fields.name: documentVersion
fields.description: Semver-style version identifier (e.g., '1.0.0', '2025-04-29'). Bounded to prevent griefing via unbounded calldata.

fields.name: documentTitle
fields.description: Human-readable document name (e.g., 'Terms of Service', 'Privacy Policy'). Bounded for shared-reference legibility.

fields.name: documentUri
fields.description: Optional locator for the affixed document (e.g. ipfs://…) so a counterparty can fetch and verify it by rehashing. The hash is the binding anchor; the locator is readability.
Non-empty list of consent-referenced documents. Each carries its own hash + version + title.
